verdict.rationale: Solid ships first-party state management built into the core framework: Context and Stores handle global state without a third-party library. Community users corroborate this, praising its deep-state handling without reducers and discussing store reactivity. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Stores API (nested updates, mutation helpers), evidence of state-management tooling or devtools integration, and broader independent hands-on corroboration at scale.
